verdict.rationale: LobeHub publishes a dedicated self-hosting documentation section. It includes a Docker Compose deployment guide, self-hosted auth configuration (email/password, GitHub, Google, Okta, Keycloak SSO) and integration guides for Azure OpenAI and Ollama, so the core product can clearly be self-hosted. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a working self-hosted deployment, and evidence beyond doc-index snippets (e.g. other deployment platforms, upgrade/maintenance guidance).
